---
name: Bug report
about: The map, the model, a readout or the Army map panel did something wrong
labels: bug
---

**What happened**
What you did, what you expected, and what it did instead. A screenshot helps.

**Where**
- [ ] The live site
- [ ] A local copy (commit: )

**Browser and device**
For example: Firefox 145 on Windows 11, Safari on an iPhone 15.

**The status line**
Copy the line next to "Refresh now" (it says when the weather was fetched), and anything in the browser console.

<!-- Leave out your address. The nearest listed town is enough. -->
